api: libvlc_media_new_path(local MP3 path); libvlc_media_parse_with_options(libvlc_media_parse_local); libvlc_media_get_meta(Title); libvlc_media_tracks_get, called from a C++17 translation unit
coverage: LLVM source coverage in VLC's MP3 preparse plugins (meta_engine/taglib.cpp meta reader; native ID3v2 parser in meta_engine/ID3Tag.h, ID3Meta.h and ID3Text.h compiled into demux/mpeg/es.c; stream_filter/skiptags.c; packetizer/mpegaudio.c) and in TagLib 1.13.1's ID3v2 parser (taglib/mpeg/id3v2), built from the pinned sources with static libvlccore and libVLC and called through libvlc_media_parse_with_options on a local file from a C++17 byte-input harness
parser_family: Two ID3v2 parsers run on VLC 3.0.24's local MP3 preparse path. The skiptags stream filter sets the ID3v2 tag aside and the MPEG audio ES demuxer (es.c) parses it with VLC's native ID3 headers. Because es.c always reports unsupported metadata, libVLC then also runs the TagLib meta reader, which re-reads the file through TagLib 1.13.1's MPEG::File and ID3v2 parser and is merged last, so its title is the one reported. The harness registers only filesystem, skiptags, es, packetizer_mpegaudio and taglib through vlc_static_modules
underlying_family: TagLib 1.13.1 ID3v2 parser with VLC's contrib patches, reached through VLC's meta_engine/taglib.cpp meta reader
shared_parser_family: VLC 3.0.24 MPEG audio ES demuxer with native ID3 headers plus the TagLib 1.13.1 meta reader, behind the libVLC media API
shared_parser_family_note: The C path (projects/mp3_id3v2/c/vlc, prepared separately) calls the same libVLC media API over the same VLC release and the same ES demuxer, native ID3 and TagLib meta reader plugins. Only the call site differs (C++17 with RAII ownership); this is not an independent parser. TagLib 1.13.1 here is VLC's own contrib pin, not the TagLib 2.3.2 release used by projects/mp3_id3v2/cpp/taglib.
